classification.difficultyReason: Read each compound inequality as an interval, independently choose open or closed endpoints, and join the values between them on supplied number lines.

content.prompt: Indicate the regions on the number line.

spec.description: Blank number line, ticks and labels 0 to 6, with x at the right.

answer.short: Open circles at 0 and 5; join the interval between them.
answer.worked: Neither endpoint is included. Draw open circles at 0 and 5 and a segment between them.

spec.description: Complete number line with open 0 and 5 joined by a blue straight interval. The template lacks straight interval segments.
Blank number line, ticks and labels 0 to 5, with x at the right.

answer.short: Closed circles at 1 and 3; join the interval between them.
answer.worked: Both endpoints are included. Draw closed circles at 1 and 3 and a segment between them.

spec.description: Complete number line with closed 1 and 3 joined by a blue straight interval. The template lacks straight interval segments.
Blank number line, ticks and labels −3 to 3, with x at the right.

answer.short: Closed circle at −2, open circle at 3; join the interval between them.
answer.worked: Include −2 and exclude 3. Draw a closed circle at −2, an open circle at 3 and a segment between them.

spec.description: Complete number line with closed −2 and open 3 joined by a blue straight interval. The template lacks straight interval segments.
Blank number line, ticks and labels −4 to 0, with x at the right.

answer.short: Closed circle at −3, open circle at −1; join the interval between them.
answer.worked: Include −3 and exclude −1. Draw a closed circle at −3, an open circle at −1 and a segment between them.

spec.description: Complete number line with closed −3 and open −1 joined by a blue straight interval. The template lacks straight interval segments.
